Pacing patch: a first run now takes about a week, fr. From the Bronze Age on, each age runs about 2.6 times as long, and events, raids, trade routes and other timers stretch to match, so each age still packs the same amount of them. Your game picks up right where you left it, no cap.
The market doesn't swap resources anymore, that era is over. The sell orders in your plan got removed, rip.
Knowledge doesn't get stored anymore, plot twist. Your scholars now lock in on one technology at a time.

Storage got a glow-up. A storage building's price now climbs way faster with each copy, and stock has no ceiling, so nothing you make goes to waste. You keep every building you have, and whatever your plan had banked got handed back to you, no cap.
